tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt:
Your friend Emma has recently moved to a new city and is feeling a bit overwhelmed. She has reached out to you for advice on how to adjust to her new environment and make new friends. You have lived in several cities before, and you have experience with finding ways to settle into new places.
Write an email to Emma. In your email, do the following:
Write as much as you can and in complete sentences.
bullets: Describe how you adjusted to a new city.
Give Emma suggestions on how she can make new friends.
Offer different ways to help her if she needs more advice.
tasks.to: Emma Subject: Tips for settling into a new city
tasks.subject: Tips for settling into a new city
tasks.title: Write an Email
